summary: Tested critical bug fix for 'network request failed' on Create My Profile. Both backend CORS and frontend onboarding flow verified working. All 4 tabs functional after profile creation.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS middleware is added after include_router(api_router) - Starlette/FastAPI processes middleware in reverse order so this still works, but convention is to add middleware before routes. No functional impact.
api.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) — consistent with frontend/.env key

success_rate.frontend: 100% - onboarding form submits, navigates to /home, all 4 tabs work

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_playwright_device_001 profile via backend test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified: Platform.OS==='web' ? '/api' : full URL in api.ts prevents CORS on web. CORS middleware uses allow_credentials=False + origins=['*'] (valid combo). Onboarding → home navigation works end-to-end.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: Two issues caused 'network request failed'. 1) Browser fetch to full backend URL triggered CORS preflight, and server had allow_credentials=True + allow_origins=['*'] which is invalid per CORS spec — browser rejects the response. 2) Fixed by: using relative /api path on web (same-origin, no CORS needed) and changing server to allow_credentials=False. Both fixes are now in place and verified.
